en: The Dyads on the Tainted (Sāsava-duka) and the Dyads on the Root-Condition (Hetu-duka).
Dependent on a state that is with-taints and is a root-cause, there arises a state that is without-taints and is not a root-cause by way of root-condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is without-taints and is a root-cause, there arises a state that is without-taints and is not a root-cause by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are four; under object-condition two … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are four. (Similar to the mundane dyad.)
